component.name: MarkdownMate
component.summary: Write notes as plain Markdown files in your own folders

description.p: MarkdownMate is a native, local-first Markdown notes app. Open any folder and your notes are just .md files in it: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. Everything is saved automatically and never overwrites changes made by another app.

ul.li: Folder sidebar that follows changes on disk, with new note, folder, rename and move to Trash
Edit, Preview and Side by side modes with synced scrolling and highlighted code
Math formulas and Mermaid diagrams in the preview, fully offline
Open Quickly by name and Find in Folder across all notes
Wiki links, tags, outline and autocompletion for links and tags
Smart lists, to-do checkboxes and bold, italic and link shortcuts
Paste or drop images straight into a note
Default, Paper, Graphite and Solarized themes in light and dark
Export as HTML, Copy as HTML and Print to PDF
Folder bookmarks, recent folders and a markdownmate:// URL scheme for automation

screenshot.caption: Edit and preview a note side by side
Plain Markdown files from your own folder
Open any note quickly by name
Math and diagrams in the preview

description.p: Focus Mode (Shift+Ctrl+J), sorting the sidebar by name, date modified or date created, Line Spacing and Text Width preferences, an option to load images from the web in the preview, instant Backlinks and a faster sidebar in large folders, less memory, and a fix for a crash on Intel graphics.

KaTeX math in the preview, Today's Note (Ctrl+D), Copy as Rich Text, Export as Plain Text and as RTF, pasting spreadsheet cells as a table, completion of code block languages and wiki link headings, TypeScript highlighting, creating a note by clicking a missing wiki link, a Default App setting, much faster Backlinks in large folders and a faster preview while typing in large notes.

Mermaid diagrams in the preview, Find in Preview (Ctrl+F), a Markdown format bar (Shift+Ctrl+M), table commands with a table bar, Toggle Task, Footnote, Move and Duplicate Line commands, Unlinked Mentions under Backlinks, updating links after a note or folder is renamed or moved, links to files and folders dropped into a note, and a much faster preview of large notes with code.

Backlinks to the current note, recent notes in Open Quickly, links that jump to a heading in the preview, inserting a table with Shift+Ctrl+T, table editing inside quotes and lists, monospace table rows, Show in Files and Copy Path in the sidebar, cleaner pasted web text, and a smoother preview with large notes.

Math formulas in the preview, pasting rich text as Markdown, table editing with Tab and Enter, find and replace, typewriter scrolling, image previews on hover, drag and drop in the sidebar, a Light/Dark style setting, a faster Side by side view, and many fixes.
First release in the PPA, with app store metadata and screenshots.
First release, available from a PPA with updates through Software Updater.
